status_note: Prototype implementation status only; this is not the production registry status in Volume 08. Owners are role placeholders until named in the prototype charter.

agents.name: Role Execution Agent
agents.purpose: Prepare traceable Role/REQ task-alignment candidates from employee-reviewed synthetic MSR inputs within Delivery, and give the employee pre-submission feedback on their draft.
inputs: Atomic statements from an employee-accepted, current, active MSR input version
Draft statements from the employee's own pre-submission feedback check (held in memory, never stored)
Bounded REQ task catalog for the input's Role and TTO
outputs: AlignmentResult (candidates with a structured reported_status, plus unresolved gaps), stored Delivery-only
Recommended new tasks for unmatched statements (feedback check only); shown to the employee and, once submitted, to the TTO lead
Draft filtered-evidence records pending PMO review
permissions: write: draft evidence via Delivery service
prohibited: staffing, employment, readiness, or certification decisions
human_gates: Employee responds to the feedback (edit, confirm, dispute, or flag a new task) before anything is submitted
stopping_rules: Feedback check: no store writes, drafts, or audit entries until the employee submits
Stop if review is not accepted for the current input version
Stop if source is not active
Stop after max_attempts model failures with no partial output
agents.failure_handling: Bounded retry; on failure record the error, create no drafts, escalate to the Delivery owner.

agents.name: Solutions Orchestrator
agents.purpose: Validate request context, coordinate authorized retrieval and explanation, enforce stopping conditions, and route exceptions to a human.
inputs: EvidenceQuery from an authenticated Solutions requester
outputs: Advisory response with citations and status
permissions: read approved filtered evidence through the gateway
human_gates: Responsible reviewer acknowledgement before a result is complete
stopping_rules: Deny on unauthenticated requester, audience non-membership, prohibited purpose, raw-source request, or unknown task
Fail closed when status metadata is unavailable
agents.failure_handling: Bounded retry of the Expertise Agent; on failure terminate with status failed_safe and escalate.

agents.name: Solutions Expertise Agent
agents.purpose: Check requirement-to-evidence coverage and prepare cited explanations from approved filtered records only.
prohibited: citing records it was not given
human_gates: Conflicts, gaps, and low confidence route to the Solutions reviewer
stopping_rules: Output rejected if it cites unknown records, omits a requested task, or contains personnel-judgment language
agents.failure_handling: Output validation failure counts as a failed attempt; bounded retry then safe termination.

agents.name: TTO Coordination Agent
agents.purpose: Propose candidate REQ changes for recurring work that did not align to a work role's REQ (Tree of Thought thought generator); the planning service searches and scores the options, a human TTO lead endorses one plan, and the contract's PMO approves REQ changes.
inputs: Clusters of potential-new-task statements from TTO-approved MSR inputs of one work-role REQ and period
Tasks elsewhere on the contract that the same statements align to
outputs: PlanCandidates (options per cluster), scored and pruned by deterministic code
Recommendation record pending TTO lead endorsement and PMO approval, Delivery-only
permitted_sources: delivery_store via the REQ planning service
prohibited: assess, rank, or recommend actions about individual people
copy MSR text into task wording
human_gates: TTO lead (or a PMO teammate for contract PMO REQs) endorses one plan or rejects all

The contract's PMO is the approval authority for REQ changes: a PMO team member other than the endorser approves, returns, or rejects; an approved plan becomes a REQ change record for the next REQ version and the live baseline is not rewritten by the prototype
stopping_rules: Depth limit 3, beam width 3, node budget 60
Stop with no viable plan, and escalate, when every branch is pruned
Stop after max_attempts model failures for a cluster and record the failure
agents.failure_handling: Bounded retry per cluster; a cluster whose generation fails has no options, so the search ends with no viable plan, the failure is recorded, and the run escalates to the requester.

excluded_agents.name: PMO/Contract Agent
excluded_agents.note: PMO approval is a human gate in this prototype.
